# Traefik — servlet-mapping-sse

App at / with the Vaadin servlet on /ui/*, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. The Hilla routers still strip /ui, but Hilla push cannot work at all over SSE: FluxConnection is WebSocket-only with no fallback.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# App at /, Vaadin servlet on /ui/*, PUSH over Server-Sent Events through a
# proxy that cannot upgrade a connection.
#
# The Hilla rules below are still needed — /HILLA/* and /connect/* stay at the
# context root whatever the Vaadin servlet is mapped to (vaadin/hilla#289) —
# but Hilla push cannot work here at all: FluxConnection subscribes with
# transport and fallbackTransport both set to websocket, with no SSE option, so
# the tests run with -Dit.websocket=false.
http:
  routers:
    hilla-push:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/ui/HILLA/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - no-websocket
        - strip-ui
        - compress
      service: vaadin

    hilla-connect:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/ui/connect/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - no-websocket
        - strip-ui
        - compress
      service: vaadin

    # Everything else reaches the backend untouched: /ui/* for the Vaadin
    # servlet (including /ui/VAADIN/push), and the root-level resources that
    # stay at the root whatever the mapping is — /VAADIN/*, /sw.js,
    # /styles.css, /manifest.webmanifest, /icons/*, /images/*, /test-redirect.
    root:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 1
      middlewares:
        - no-websocket
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    # Traefik upgrades on every route, so a proxy that cannot upgrade has to be
    # built by removing the client's intent. An empty value deletes the header
    # rather than setting it empty.
    no-websocket:
      headers:
        customRequestHeaders:
          Upgrade: ""
          Connection: ""

    strip-ui:
      stripPrefix:
        prefixes:
          - "/ui"

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
